name: BACH_0099_FSIM_resample3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (65%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Degraded frozen section failed quality checks; prompts recut, deeper levels, and margin deferral [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 65%, InSitu 34%, others ≤1% [F1] | Leans invasive; InSitu possible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, alpha 0.10) | Cannot separate Invasive, InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.30 reliability (flagged); 100% OOD [F6] | Degraded input; low reliability |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class: false | Independent models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 (80%) Invasive; 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Neighbors mostly invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.12, +0.62) [F2]; 0/20 check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.13, +0.48) [F3]; 20/20 check · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · High (+2.03, +0.38) [F4]; 3/20 check · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.37); 19/20 check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion drops invasive score beyond random (+0.011, CI +0.002 to +0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resample artifact (severity 3) distorted tissue; drafted recut or deeper levels may change findings.
- High-risk foci are InSitu carcinoma (34%, regions 5, 9; contrast BACH_0272) lacking stromal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 6, 10**: Inspect top-risk tiles (99–100%) for true invasion versus unreliable necrosis.
2. **Regions 5, 7, 9**: Compare duct-confined atypia (5, 9) against weak invasion score (7).
3. **Regions 0, 3, 11**: Assess resample artifact, lymphocytes (3), and need for recut.
